description: This file defines a trait SignatureTrait that provides methods for calculating signatures for AWS Signature Version 4, including scope creation and signing key generation, used internally within AWS SDK for PHP.

methods.name: createScope
methods.description: Constructs the scope string used in AWS SignatureV4, incorporating date, region, and service.

methods.name: getSigningKey
methods.description: Generates and caches the signing key for AWS SignatureV4 based on date, region, service, and secret key.
